// This capture program runs only inside the frozen 82834ba Go module.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"time"

	"retrom/internal/adapter/files/blobstore"
	"retrom/internal/adapter/metadata/hasheous"
	"retrom/internal/model/jobs"
	"retrom/internal/model/saves"
)

type captureInput struct {
	FixedNow    string                 `json:"fixedNow"`
	HTTPRawBody string                 `json:"httpRawBody"`
	Hashes      hasheous.ContentHashes `json:"hashes"`
	BlobBody    string                 `json:"blobBody"`
	Jobs        []jobs.Snapshot        `json:"jobs"`
	Saves       []saveInput            `json:"saves"`
}

type saveInput struct {
	Label            string  `json:"label"`
	ResourceKind     string  `json:"resourceKind"`
	SaveStateID      string  `json:"saveStateId"`
	PreviewID        string  `json:"previewId"`
	CheckpointFormat string  `json:"checkpointFormat"`
	ScreenshotURL    *string `json:"screenshotUrl"`
	CreatedAtMS      int64   `json:"createdAtMs"`
	Name             string  `json:"name"`
	DiscIndex        *int    `json:"discIndex"`
	Version          int64   `json:"version"`
	ActiveDurationMS int64   `json:"activeDurationMs"`
}

type (
	fileFact   struct{ Path, SHA256 string }
	provenance struct {
		BaselineCommit, GoVersion, InputFile, InputSHA256    string
		CaptureProgram, CaptureProgramSHA256, CaptureCommand string
		Sources                                              []fileFact
	}
)
type metadataCapture struct {
	CandidateJSON, NullCandidateJSON, EmptyCandidateJSON      string
	RawResponseBase64, RequestBody, RequestDigest, HashDigest string
	RequestMethod, RequestURL, Outcome                        string
}
type (
	saveCapture   struct{ Label, JSON string }
	captureResult struct {
		SchemaVersion int
		Provenance    provenance
		Metadata      metadataCapture
		JobJSON       []string
		Saves         []saveCapture
		BlobFactsJSON string
	}
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("expected the fixed input JSON path")
	}
	inputBytes := read(os.Args[1])
	var input captureInput
	must(json.Unmarshal(inputBytes, &input))
	result := captureResult{
		SchemaVersion: 1, Provenance: captureProvenance(inputBytes),
		Metadata: captureMetadata(input), BlobFactsJSON: captureBlob(input.BlobBody),
	}
	for _, job := range input.Jobs {
		result.JobJSON = append(result.JobJSON, encode(job))
	}
	for _, value := range input.Saves {
		result.Saves = append(result.Saves, captureSave(value))
	}
	output, err := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
	must(err)
	_, err = os.Stdout.Write(append(output, '\n'))
	must(err)
}

func captureProvenance(input []byte) provenance {
	result := provenance{
		BaselineCommit: "82834bade1648da3067ebda1b1fc89c18577fd6a", GoVersion: runtime.Version(),
		InputFile: "rf03-values-input.json", InputSHA256: digest(input),
		CaptureProgram:       "rf03-value-capture.go.txt",
		CaptureProgramSHA256: digest(read("internal/rf03valuecapture/main.go")),
		CaptureCommand:       "GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go run ./internal/rf03valuecapture ../../../internal/testkit/refactor/testdata/rf03-values-input.json",
	}
	for _, path := range []string{
		"go.mod",
		"go.sum",
		"internal/model/jobs/progress_types.go",
		"internal/model/saves/manual_result.go",
		"internal/adapter/metadata/hasheous/asset_fetch.go",
		"internal/adapter/metadata/hasheous/asset_read.go",
		"internal/adapter/metadata/hasheous/provider.go",
		"internal/adapter/files/blobstore/blobstore.go",
		"internal/adapter/files/blobstore/nofollow_linux.go",
		"internal/foundation/legacychecksum/checksum.go",
	} {
		result.Sources = append(result.Sources, fileFact{Path: path, SHA256: digest(read(path))})
	}
	return result
}

type captureHTTP struct{ body, method, url, requestBody string }

func (client *captureHTTP) Do(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	content, err := io.ReadAll(request.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	client.method, client.url, client.requestBody = request.Method, request.URL.String(), string(content)
	return &http.Response{
		StatusCode: http.StatusOK, Header: http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}},
		Body: io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader([]byte(client.body))),
	}, nil
}

func captureMetadata(input captureInput) metadataCapture {
	now, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, input.FixedNow)
	must(err)
	client := &captureHTTP{body: input.HTTPRawBody}
	provider := hasheous.New(client, nil, func() time.Time { return now })
	value, err := provider.LookupByHash(context.Background(), input.Hashes)
	must(err)
	if value.Outcome != hasheous.OutcomeHit || value.Candidate == nil {
		panic("frozen fixture did not produce a candidate")
	}
	hashDigest, err := hasheous.RequestDigest(input.Hashes)
	must(err)
	if string(value.RequestBody) != client.requestBody {
		panic("frozen result request body differed from sent HTTP body")
	}
	return metadataCapture{
		CandidateJSON:     encode(value.Candidate),
		NullCandidateJSON: encode(hasheous.Candidate{RawResponse: []byte("must stay opaque"), NormalizationUTC: 2026}),
		EmptyCandidateJSON: encode(hasheous.Candidate{
			Metadata: map[string]any{}, Evidence: map[string]any{}, Assets: []hasheous.AssetRef{},
			RawResponse: []byte("must stay opaque"), NormalizationUTC: 2026,
		}),
		RawResponseBase64: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(value.RawResponse),
		RequestBody:       string(value.RequestBody), RequestDigest: value.RequestDigest, HashDigest: hashDigest,
		RequestMethod: client.method, RequestURL: client.url, Outcome: string(value.Outcome),
	}
}

func captureSave(input saveInput) saveCapture {
	value := saves.ManualResult{
		ResourceKind: input.ResourceKind, SaveStateID: input.SaveStateID, PreviewID: input.PreviewID,
		CheckpointFormat: input.CheckpointFormat, ScreenshotURL: input.ScreenshotURL, CreatedAtMS: input.CreatedAtMS,
		Name: input.Name, DiscIndex: input.DiscIndex, Version: input.Version, ActiveDurationMS: input.ActiveDurationMS,
	}
	return saveCapture{Label: input.Label, JSON: encode(value)}
}

func captureBlob(body string) string {
	directory, err := os.MkdirTemp("internal/rf03valuecapture", "cas-")
	must(err)
	defer func() { must(os.RemoveAll(directory)) }()
	store, err := blobstore.Open(directory)
	must(err)
	value, err := store.Put(bytes.NewReader([]byte(body)))
	must(err)
	// Only immutable, verified facts cross the new Model boundary.
	return encode(struct {
		SHA256, MD5, SHA1, CRC32 string
		Size                     int64
	}{
		value.SHA256, value.MD5, value.SHA1, value.CRC32, value.Size,
	})
}

func read(path string) []byte    { value, err := os.ReadFile(path); must(err); return value }
func digest(value []byte) string { sum := sha256.Sum256(value); return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) }
func encode(value any) string    { data, err := json.Marshal(value); must(err); return string(data) }
func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Errorf("capture frozen RF03 value: %w", err))
	}
}
